method_change.reason: Opponent-family harvesting had reached diminishing returns at 422 identified games. Stage 1 policy calls for candidate-universe extraction first and opponent/source families as bounded repair, so the unit was changed to multi-opponent season reconstruction.

source_mix: contemporary Associated Press / United Press / local college-score reporting preserved by Oregon Historic Newspapers
admission_rule: Only played-game identities with a stable on-court W/L result were admitted. Schedule-only mentions were discovery/control evidence and were not added as games.
date_policy: Exact game_date is written only when printed directly or mechanically fixed by publication date plus an explicit 'last night', weekday, weekend-series, or official-schedule statement. Otherwise blank.
site_policy: H/A/N is written only when source-explicit. Geography alone never creates site_type.

score_conflicts.stable_fields: Gonzaga win; Gonzaga score 90; neutral at Baker

rejected_bulk_source.source: West Coast Conference historical men's basketball record book
rejected_bulk_source.reason: Multi-column PDF text was interleaved and produced impossible season grouping; screenshot renderer could not provide a reliable visual verification. No rows in this tranche rely on that scrambled extraction.

stopping_note: This is a bulk candidate-universe expansion checkpoint, not a claim that the five seasons are fully closed. Remaining arithmetic differences are research diagnostics only and never authorize anonymous games.
